description: We are high school students passionate about space exploration, science, technology, and video games. Through this project, we aim to combine scientific knowledge, creativity, and teamwork to create an interactive space simulation where players can explore, make decisions, and learn about the challenges of space missions and life beyond Earth.
summary: Mission Mars, is an educational game that introduces players to the decision-making process behind space missions. Players must plan their journey, manage resources, respond to unexpected situations, and establish a sustainable base on Mars. Through strategy and problem-solving, we aim to make space exploration more accessible and engaging for students.
details:
What does it do or how does it work?

Mission Mars is an educational space simulation game in which players must plan and manage a mission to Mars. Before launch, they select specialists, equipment, systems, and supplies while staying within budget and payload limits. During the journey, they must manage resources, respond to emergencies, and make decisions when facing hazards such as solar storms or technical failures. Once on Mars, they explore the environment using a rover, research resources, gather scientific data, and build infrastructure to maintain a functional and sustainable base.

What are its benefits?

The game helps develop skills related to planning, problem-solving, and managing limited resources. Players must assess risks, prioritize needs, and understand how a single decision can impact the entire course of a space mission. Additionally, it introduces concepts of planetary exploration, scientific research, and sustainability in extreme environments.

What is the expected impact of the project?

Our goal is to bring space exploration closer to students through an interactive experience. We want users to understand that space missions require constant planning, adaptation to unexpected situations, and efficient use of available resources. The core message we aim to convey is that every decision matters in space.

What tools, languages, hardware, or software were used?

To develop the project, we used web technologies based on:

  • HTML
  • JavaScript
  • React
  • Three.js for the 3D environments and elements
  • Tailwind CSS for the visual interface

We also used Microsoft Copilot as a support tool to organize ideas, structure concepts, and improve project planning, while the game mechanics design and overall concept were developed by the team.

How is the project creative?

Mission Mars combines several stages of a space mission into a single interactive experience. Players not only travel to Mars, but also have to prepare before launch, face unexpected situations during the journey, explore the planet using a rover, and develop a functional base. Combining resource management, exploration, scientific research, and construction allows us to showcase different aspects of a space mission in a way that is accessible to students.

What factors did your team consider?

During development, we considered:

  • The efficient management of limited resources.
  • Decision-making under conditions of uncertainty.
  • The risks that can affect a space mission.
  • The exploration and research of Mars.
  • The progressive construction of a sustainable base.
  • Accessibility for students through easy-to-understand mechanics.
  • The balance between learning and entertainment.

Our main objective was to create an experience that allows players to better understand the challenges of a space mission without requiring advanced technical knowledge.
